assessment_basis: Repository README, architecture, implementation entry points, interface documentation and CI definitions were inspected for the recorded gates. The full target build and test matrix was not re-run during this adoption; this is not a new CI certification.

evidence.claim: Defines the native sample-workstation purpose, offline audio scope, supported targets and explicit non-goals.
Documents the C++20 audio core, optional Qt desktop and offline processing boundaries.
Provides repository security and vulnerability-reporting guidance.
Defines the native C++20 engine, optional desktop and test build targets.
Builds and tests the native engine and desktop targets across declared CI runners.
Contains the native Qt desktop implementation and its connected application panels.
Contains regression tests for native audio, import/export and application contracts.
Defines the compiled C++20 engine and desktop targets used by the native build path.
Defines the source-import and optional versioned Reaper runtime integration boundaries.
Contains regression coverage for the audio engine, manifests and integration behavior.
Exercises native engine, desktop and contract checks in CI.

next_gate: Run deterministic golden renders on each declared native target.
Stress plugin lifecycle, invalid inputs, import/export and DSP failure handling.
Record repeatable latency, memory and compatibility budgets for the offline renderer.
